title: Your Mortgage Has Been Lying to You — 86% Is Interest
hook: You've been making mortgage payments feeling like a homeowner — but in year one, 86 cents of every dollar goes to your bank, not your home.
angle: Amortization schedule reveal — most homeowners never see this chart and don't realize how little equity they're actually building in the early years
audience: Current homeowners under 10 years into their mortgage, first-time buyers considering a 30-year loan
key_numbers: 86% of year-one payments are pure interest
After 5 years on a $350K loan: paid $136K, gained only $20,500 in equity
$200 extra/month saves $51,000 total and cuts 6 years off the loan
